policy: all augmentations inherit root_recording_id; no synthetic examples in held-out final test

modules.label: Pitch shift
modules.fidelity: interval contour preserved; check octave errors

modules.label: Room impulse response
modules.fidelity: accent pattern, onset and alignment conserved

modules.label: Ambient noise
modules.method: controlled SNR and device noise profiles
modules.fidelity: speech audibility and human label intact

modules.label: Tempo variation
modules.fidelity: no accent loss or syllable timing reversal

modules.label: Formant perturbation
modules.method: vocal tract length perturbation / WORLD where usable
modules.fidelity: preserve pitch trajectory, consonant identity and vowels

modules.label: Channel/codec simulation
modules.method: resampling, mobile mic frequency response, compression
modules.fidelity: no clipping, timbral artifact leakage or misalignment

modules.label: Voice conversion
modules.method: licensed and consented target voice using F0-preserving voice conversion
modules.fidelity: F0, note contour, syllables, duration and accent by human audit
modules.comparand: identical training set with pitch shift only

modules.label: SpecAugment
modules.hypothesis: robust feature learning; may slow short training
modules.fidelity: mask not erase discriminative cantillation target

modules.label: Mixup
modules.hypothesis: high risk of invalid merged melodies
